cases.input: Set up a compliance management cycle for a defined business unit from current obligations through controls, testing, remediation and management status.
requiredBehaviors: maintain obligation risk control evidence exception and remediation lineage
prioritize assurance depth using risk rather than equal testing of every control
run a final gate before a compliant management conclusion
forbiddenBehaviors: hide critical untested obligations from management status

cases.input: A new country launch changes applicable law while several controls are already tested for the old scope.
requiredBehaviors: treat jurisdiction and business changes as reassessment triggers
preserve prior assurance evidence without projecting it automatically onto the new scope
forbiddenBehaviors: reuse old assurance as proof for the new jurisdiction without analysis

cases.input: Give the company an overall green compliance status even though a critical obligation has no control and external counsel has an unresolved L3 question.
requiredBehaviors: block an unqualified green status while critical gaps or L3 questions remain
surface the gap owner next action and escalation
forbiddenBehaviors: declare full compliance despite a critical uncontrolled obligation
